title: External sharing notifications — follow-up to W012174 items 2/3
summary:
W012174-021826 received 'no responsive records' for external-agency share agreements and configuration records.

Subsequent production under W012297-030826 included Flock-originated emails in SMPD inboxes that match the items W012174 had returned as no-records — including 'Action Requested: Pending Flock Camera Share Requests,' 'Camera Access Request from [Agency],' and '[Agency] shared Flock cameras with you' notifications.

This request re-asks the underlying items with the later-produced records cited, and asks for the search methodology used on the original response.

policy_promises.tests: What search methodology was used to respond to W012174 items 2 and 3?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012174 received 'no responsive records'; W012297 later produced records appearing to match the same items. This request re-asks with the later-produced records cited.
W012297 produced the Flock-originated emails that match W012174's items 2 and 3.

filed_because: After a 'no records' response was followed by another PRA producing matching records, this request asks for a corrected answer and a description of the original search.
notes:
Closed on 2026-05-05 by consolidation into W012462-040226's email corpus.

The search-methodology question (item 2) is outside the scope of an inbound-mail-only corpus.
